title: Remove or implement TrustStore.verify_or_pin allow_upgrade
description: P4 API correctness: TrustStore.verify_or_pin() exposes and documents allow_upgrade, but the parameter is never read and the method has no requested trust level to apply. Passing allow_upgrade=True has exactly the same behavior as False, so callers can believe an upgrade was authorized when none occurred. Remove the no-op argument or define an explicit validated upgrade contract and add behavior tests.
